failureMessage: search_issues/list_issues/actions_list return every match with its full body when uncapped, which has hard-failed the tool-result token cap here repeatedly (#734 twice, #753, #760)

guardToolCalls.what: a {tool} call with no perPage cap
guardToolCalls.fix: pass a small perPage (5–10) — and for search_issues/list_issues, fields too (e.g. ['number','title','state']) to strip the body, since perPage alone doesn't stop a single oversized result

failureMessage: guessing a large tail_lines to diagnose a CI failure can itself exceed get_job_logs' token limit (#1101 hit this at tail_lines: 2406)

guardToolCalls.fix: skip the guess — call without tail_lines (or the small default) to get the saved-to-disk log path, then grep that file for the failure marker (not ok, FAIL)
